Handle.description: An opaque token for a checked instance, carried by the other calls.

InvokeContext.description: The run an `invoke` is part of.

anchors.description:
Where it sits — `stream_id`, `thread_id`, `effort_id`, `turn_id`,
`agent_session_id`, `snapshot_id` — as the event envelope has them,
`null` where the run has none.

cause.description: The id of the event that caused it, when one did.

run.description: The run's id in oxplow's records.

context.description:
The run this call is part of, as oxplow records it. A provider may
log or forward it; it changes nothing about the call.

idempotency_key.description:
The write's idempotency key, when the host may send it again (a
reply lost, a call cut off). A provider that declares
`idempotent_writes` does a write sent twice with one key once and
answers the second as the first; a key sent with another write is
`InvalidInput` at `/idempotency_key`. One that doesn't declare it
may ignore the key.
